test_name: Arm addons swapped to body slot apply to both arms - 97b2ed19-7279-4e62-8fec-08a321b17317
summary: The loadout UI only checked that the dragged addon fits the slot it is dropped on. When that slot was occupied, the swap moved the displaced addon into the dragged addon's old slot without any check. Addons allowed on both arm and body (Weight Pack, Gash Bang, Magshot, etc.) therefore let you swap an arm-only addon (Overdrives, Megafrictor, Major Cabal) into the body, or a body-only addon (Phantom Limb, Triple Bus) onto an arm. MechUI.DetermineAction now also checks that the displaced item is allowed in the dragged item's slot for swaps between two mech slots, using the CanSwap check the inventory route already has. I verified it in the Rampage level-up shop: the body Weight Pack can no longer swap with Overdrives or Megafrictor, the arm Weight Pack can no longer swap with Phantom Limb, the loadout stays unchanged when you try, and legal swaps between arms still work.
instructions:
TASK: [BUG] RAMPAGE: You can swap arm addons to the body, getting the benefits on both arms and none of the negatives

DESCRIPTION:
> (overdrives, mega frictor, major cabal).  Some body addons still get their benefit on an arm (phantom Limb on busted arm, triple bus, etc)

<https://discord.com/channels/276104181067022336/1431327982659833896/1549131541098274878>

REQUEST (from Amit):
investigate and fix, do not use /conversations or any other things that lets you see previous conversations

EXTRA (found on the card):
Discord thread link referenced in description: https://discord.com/channels/276104181067022336/1431327982659833896/1549131541098274878 (not accessible, content not retrievable here)
Thread mentions trying to repro in play mode before fixing.
verified: Body (Cockpit) Weight Pack selected: arm slots holding Overdrives and Megafrictor return None; ApplySelectedItem onto Overdrives leaves the loadout unchanged
Arm Weight Pack selected: Cockpit slot holding Phantom Limb returns None; ApplySelectedItem onto it leaves the loadout unchanged

Regression: arm Weight Pack dropped on the other arm's Overdrives still swaps; Cockpit Weight Pack and arm Weight Pack can still swap with each other; empty addon slots still Equip; with Overdrives selected, body slots are None and arm slots are Swap/Equip
not_done: Major Cabal and Triple Bus were not equipped in the test; they are arm-only and cockpit-only like Overdrives and Phantom Limb, so they go through the same CanSwap check
The inventory-to-slot swap was not exercised: the Rampage shop shows no inventory slots. That path is unchanged in code
Saved runs that already have an addon in the wrong slot are not migrated
